t: Get On The Midnight Train To Georgia: Kat Sims v Edward Carter
d: “Kat” says Edward went from being kind and trustworthy to closed off and unfaithful. Edward says “Kat's” know-it-all attitude has him taking a step back in the relationship.

t: Walked in on My Lover Cheating: "Nicole" Barron v "Danny" Honeyghan
d: “Nicole” says “Danny's” immaturity, cheating, and lack of respect has them hanging by a thread. “Danny” says it's “Nicole's” anger issues that have caused the rift between them.

t: Are We Going to be a Family or Not!: Christina Craig v John Piggott
d: Christina says John gaslights her and uses her past against her. John says Christina's emotional anger from her past trauma is the real reason they are not seeing eye-to-eye.

t: I'm Tired of Being Your Wife, I'm Tired of Your Disrespect: Marquisha Holmes v "Chris" Holmes
d: Marquisha argues instead of “Chris” focusing on being a family man he promised her, he has done nothing but lie and cheat on her. “Chris” says he's tired of the accusations!

t: You Gambled Our Money and Love Away!: "Jeanie" Cole v Gary Grimes
d: “Jeanie” says her husband has a gambling problem, disappears for days, and has even moved in with an escort! Gary says “Jeanie's” behavior is what's causing the rift between them.

t: You May Be a Gambler, But I'm Not: Kalema Rogers v "Charnelle" Davis
d: Kalema says “Charnelle” has a bad gambling problem that is trickling its way into an already uneasy relationship. “Charnelle" blames their lack of communication on their issues.

t: Stop Denying Paternity of Our Child!: Lakvia Conrad v Karl Kindrow
d: Lakyia says Karl is an insecure cheater who denies the paternity of their 3-month-old daughter. Karl says he can't trust Lakyia and wants to prove that he didn't father her child.

t: Party Girl Dilemma: Mobolaji Agbaje v Jazmin Brown
d: Mobolaji is fed up with the defendant's party lifestyle and demands that she starts acting like a wife. Jazmin claims it's Mobolaji's lack of affection that has her ready to leave.

t: Mom Says “Cancel That Wedding!”: Devonne Dunnings v Julian James
d: Devonne argues Julian is a conniving liar, cheater and is irresponsible. Julian says Devonne's false accusations are the real reason they find themselves in Divorce Court.

t: Separated Spouses: Derrick Smith v Karman Okarma
d: Derrick says his wife's controlling and paranoid behavior has him rethinking this relationship. Karmen refutes it's Derrick's temper that has ruined their once loving relationship

t: I Gave an Inch and You Took a Mile, I Want a Divorce!: Shamire Wilson v Tavaris Wilson
d: Shamire says Tavaris is nothing but a cheater and after blowing a second chance she had given him  she's finally done. Tavaris argues Shamire's paranoid antics are the real issue.

t: Everyone Is Telling Me Not To Marry You
st: Jazlyn Perkins v Daniel Weisberg Pt 1
d: Jazlyn says even though Daniel proposed six months ago, she suspects he's been spending his time and their money on another woman. Daniel says Jazlyn has become too overbearing!

t: Everyone Is Telling Me Not To Marry You
st: Jazlyn Perkins v Daniel Weisberg Pt 2
d: Jazlyn says even though Daniel proposed six months ago, she suspects he's been spending his time and their money on another woman. Daniel says Jazlyn has become too overbearing!

t: I'm Needy Because You Keep Bread Crumbing Me: Ashley Robinson v Myron Jewell
d: Ashley's tired of feeling alone in the relationship, if something doesn't change, she's out the door. Myron says Ashley's complaining has taken a major toll on his well-being.

t: My Future Wife Is A Human Tracking Device: Xenia Jacovo v Raul Celaya
d: Xenia says Raul is a cheating liar who spends more time playing video games then he does with her. Raul says Xenia is more concerned about tracking him than being a good partner.

t: Lost Lover: Tichana Birt v Mario Harris
d: Tichana says Mario's alcoholism has ruined almost every holiday they've spent together and she's over it. Mario says Tichana is constantly blowing things out of proportion!
